distribution.narrative: 黄复生等 (2015) supports occurrence in 云南. Beaver & Liu (2010) adds a first Taiwan record, with material from Kinmen, Nantou (Huison), Taichung and Taipei.

host_note: 黄复生等 (2015) explicitly reports Albizia julibrissin, Castanopsis indica and Hevea brasiliensis. Beaver & Liu (2010) describes a wide range of angiosperm trees and shrubs but does not enumerate additional host taxa in this Source Record; the broad prose is retained as context and is not split into inferred taxa.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Hypothenemus areccae (Hornung, 1842).

nomenclature_note: The current accepted identity is Hypothenemus areccae (Hornung, 1842), VSN_3164. 黄复生等 (2015) and Beaver & Liu (2010) both preserve authorship (Hornung). A previous profile record gave authorship Wood, 1956 was inconsistent with the canonical integrated taxonomic backbone identity and is not used for the current accepted authorship.
